sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Ipomoea pulcherrima is an upright shrub or small tree endemic to Peru, known in particular from the Apurímac Valley. The accessible references do not provide a reliable height.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: The plate shows a shrub-like habit and leaves compatible with available descriptions. The illustrated pink-purple flower colour is not confirmed by a reliable source and should not be treated as an established feature.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No reliable food use is documented.
